 Follow ‘DWTS’ Celeb Trying to Hide Secret Relationship With Pro as Things Get “Flirtier”
 Mehera Bonner Tue, October 27, 2026 at 12:25 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. A DWTS Pro and Celeb Are in a Secret Relationship Ser Baffo - Getty Images Hello everyone who is convinced Dancing With the Stars frontrunner Ezra Frech and pro Hailey Bills are dating. All signs point to...they are! Though, the pair have been intentionally keeping whatever's happening between them secretive.
 "Ezra and Hailey are still hanging out off the show and they're getting even flirtier," a source tells The Sun . "They seem really, really happy when they are together. They laugh a LOT."
 Instagram
 As for why they aren't going public with the relationship, the insider adds that "They are being really careful not to post each other right now because they don't want the chatter about them potentially dating to overtake everything else. Ezra is really serious about making it to the finals and even winning this show. At the end of the day, he has the mindset of an Olympian. So he's not letting a crush get in the way of winning the show. So they're being strict about not posting together until the season is over."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Rumors about Ezra and Hailey have been swirling for a few weeks thanks to several cute videos that people have been reading into, and earlier this month a source said , "Hailey and Ezra are always hanging out backstage together; they're the cutest. They have gotten really flirty with each other and are openly flirty in front of the cast. It's gotten to the point where all the pros and contestants and even the crew members are pushing for them to date. They both are very genuine and have a similar sense of humor, so they've been getting along so well and getting closer every week of the competition."
 Honestly, love them, couldn't be more invested, etc.
